edits.new:
| TC-P2-E2035-CON-06 | AC6 | Component | The nine sub-tables present; 12.3 and 12.4 with no event type; the two tables of 12.7; the six fakes match the document |
| TC-P2-E2035-CON-07 | AC6 | Component | Boundary: the two tables of 12.7 are the only tables owned; no other table is owned, read or copied; ASM-3438 |
| TC-P2-E2035-CON-08 | BR1 | Contract | The resolve is side-effect free; the read composes it; the fill is the only write, made through the case owner |
| TC-P2-E2035-CON-09 | BR2 | Contract | No case column, task row or lock is written by this service; the case write is the rwb-case call only |
| TC-P2-E2035-CON-10 | BR3 | Contract | This contract declares /api/recovery/integration/v1 and rwb-integration only; other bases are consumed, not declared |
| TC-P2-E2035-CON-11 | BR4 | Contract | The catalog is read only through RuleCatalog.row(ruleId, packageVersion); no workbook, DRL or rule table is read |
| TC-P2-E2035-CON-12 | BR5 | Contract | The kit types RuleResult and NoPackageInForce are used; no second rule engine appears in this service |
| TC-P2-E2035-CON-13 | BR6 | Contract | Action text, owner role, timer, role class, service level and calendar are read through owners' contracts and written by no code path |
| TC-P2-E2035-CON-14 | BR7 | Component | The same resolve input gives the same answer on repeated calls |
| TC-P2-E2035-CON-15 | BR8 | Contract | A fill raises at most one open NEXT_ACTION_MISSING task per case; the Schedule carries overlap SKIP and a catch-up window |
| TC-P2-E2035-CON-16 | BR9 | Contract | Events, activity inputs, examples and fakes carry case IDs, role codes, rule IDs, version labels and dates only |
| TC-P2-E2035-CON-17 | BR10 | Contract | An unfixed consumed field, path or error carries the placeholder and one gap row with its assumption rows |
| TC-P2-E2035-CON-18 | BR11 | Contract | The flag rwb.casewf.next-action is a platform feature flag, not a column of a service table |
| TC-P2-E2035-CON-19 | BR12 | Contract | The legacy key values (package version RES-2026.12 and rows R-RES-04, R-SET-13, R-RES-03, R-DEV-05, R-RES-07) are carried unchanged |
